title: Common mysqli application APIs through ZtdMysqli versus native mysqli

scope.database: Disposable MySQL; connection via ZTD_MYSQL_HOST, ZTD_MYSQL_PORT, ZTD_MYSQL_DB, ZTD_MYSQL_USER, ZTD_MYSQL_PASSWORD

options.mysqli: MYSQLI_REPORT_ERROR | MYSQLI_REPORT_STRICT, temporarily MYSQLI_REPORT_OFF for the errno checks; MYSQLI_OPT_INT_AND_FLOAT_NATIVE for the typing option checks
options.ztd: defaults; fromMysqli() wrapping; new ZtdMysqli() + options() + real_connect()

scope.setup: Empty disposable database. The native control creates and drops one random physical table per control connection; ZTD connections create session-only tables with random names. Runtime versions are emitted by the script.
